UPDATE indexer_sources SET
            api_calls_today = CASE
                WHEN last_api_reset_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
                THEN 1
                ELSE api_calls_today + 1
            END,
            last_api_reset_at = CASE
                WHEN last_api_reset_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
                THEN NOW()
                ELSE last_api_reset_at
            END
        WHERE id = $1
